title: National Alliance puts forward ministerial candidates
summary_full: The National Alliance (NA) is proposing the following ministers for ministerial posts in the new government being formed by Andris Kulbergs (United List): Jānis Dombrava for the post of Minister for the Interior, Nauris Puntulis for Culture, and Ilze Indriksone, the current Minister for Education, for the post of Minister for Welfare.
